$comment: Quality gates for the qa, spec-build and spec-check skills (node .agents/skills/qa/scripts/gates.mjs fast|full) and the Claude Code hooks in .claude/hooks/. `full` mirrors the `check` job of .github/workflows/ci.yml; the `docker` job runs in CI only (AGENTS.md, Spec workflow profile). `stop` runs in the Claude Code Stop hook after every turn that changed code and must take seconds (`{cargo-packages}` = `-p` for each changed crate, minus `excludePackages`); `fast` runs before every commit (Claude Code commit gate) and in spec-build after each block; both are filtered by `paths` (prefixes of changed repository paths). `needs` lists the ids a gate waits for; gates without needs between them run in parallel. Optional per gate: `fix` (auto-fix command), `note` (guidance when it is red).

full.name: cargo test
full.note: The oracle ratchets (fixtures/*-baseline.toml) only go up: fix the parser or engine, never lower a baseline. SOFARR_UPDATE_BASELINE=1 is for raising it after an improvement or for a changed fixture set.

full.name: agent skills in sync
full.note: Shared skills are edited in amigo-labs/skills and synced with `node .agents/sync.mjs`; this repository's own skills are edited in .agents/skills, then `node .agents/sync.mjs --mirror`.
